# TeeJay's Tech Tools

> All-in-one dealer websites connected to live inventory, plus Google Ads for in-stock vehicles and units with plain-English reporting. TeeJay Crawford is the founder and accountable operator.

Important notes:

- Public pages may be crawled. Utility, success, and private surfaces are excluded or noindex.
- The free audit uses public sources and does not guarantee ranking, inclusion, or citation.
- Prototype, staged, deployed, and live are separate states.
- Lead submission remains a human action.

Site references:

- [Canonical site](https://teejaystechtools.com/): Official public website.
- [XML sitemap](https://teejaystechtools.com/sitemap.xml): Complete indexable URL inventory.
- [Crawler policy](https://teejaystechtools.com/robots.txt): Public crawler access rules.
- [Contact TeeJay](https://teejaystechtools.com/contact.html): Private business inquiry form.

## Start here

- [All-in-one dealer websites](https://teejaystechtools.com/dealer-websites.html): Inventory-feed websites with search, VDPs, leads, finance, service, SEO, Google Ads landing paths, and support.
- [Inventory feeds and merchandising](https://teejaystechtools.com/inventory-merchandising.html): Feed health, descriptions, media and option exceptions, and dealer-controlled inventory quality.
- [Inventory Google Ads](https://teejaystechtools.com/marketing-truth.html): Google Ads for in-stock inventory with relevant landing pages, shopper-action tracking, and plain-English reporting.
- [Dealership solutions](https://teejaystechtools.com/dealerships.html): The connected dealer website and inventory Google Ads offer, with supporting inventory and reporting services.

## Dealership systems

- [Inventory Merchandising Guard](https://teejaystechtools.com/inventory-merchandising.html): Guarded listing-quality operations.
- [Inventory descriptions and merchandising](https://teejaystechtools.com/inventory-descriptions.html): VIN-matched, evidence-backed vehicle descriptions and dealer-controlled review.
- [Inventory Google Ads and reporting](https://teejaystechtools.com/marketing-truth.html): In-stock campaigns, useful landing pages, shopper-action tracking, and clear next steps.
- [DealerLister Facebook inventory plugin](https://teejaystechtools.com/autolister.html): Human-reviewed Marketplace listing preparation from authorized dealer inventory.
- [Reputation management](https://teejaystechtools.com/reputation-visibility.html): Exact-location review, response, listing-consistency, escalation, and public-state operations.
- [Custom dealer software](https://teejaystechtools.com/custom-dealer-software.html): Inventory applications, integrations, dashboards, workflow automation, and governed agents built around dealer operations.
